versions.changelog:
Initial release of vehicle-license-recognition-and-extract.

- Provides precise extraction of all main fields (20+) from Chinese vehicle licenses, including both main and supplementary pages.
- Supports image, local file, folder, URL, or Base64 inputs using Laiye Technology's ADP CLI for zero-configuration, out-of-the-box use.
- Returns structured JSON suitable for direct business system integration.
- Features quickstart guides, workflow instructions, error handling, and mapping for various recognition scenarios (single, batch, async).
- Offers free API usage quota on registration (200 extractions/month).
